in_sanskrit.name: अक्षत्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is unbroken, inviolable, immutable, whole, and perfect.

in_hindi.name: अक्षत
in_hindi.long_meaning: Aksar (infallible, unchangeable) + ta (marker of the perfective aspect)

in_telugu.name: అక్షద్
in_telugu.long_meaning: Aksh (eye, witness) + d (marker of the perfective aspect)

in_marathi.name: Aksat
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aksat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Aksat is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘aksas’, meaning unchanging, immovable, and immutable. It is a name of significance in Hindu mythology, associated with the concept of the imperishable and the eternal.
